verdict.rationale: The only evaluation-related evidence is the webhooks page, which says webhooks can be used to 'score responses' and run 'real-time evaluation'. That describes a building block for wiring up your own external scorer, not a built-in, configurable LLM-as-a-judge evaluator in Helicone itself. No evidence shows Helicone shipping its own judge evaluators, so this applicable axis gets no credit.
